item.title: Tencent Opens Beta for Eciyuan AI Gaming Companion Agent
item.description:
Tencent has launched the beta of Eciyuan, its first dedicated AI gaming companion agent, targeting PC players with anthropomorphic real-time voice interaction. The agent can perceive gameplay footage to answer questions and interact, supports PC and mobile QQ chat, and plans features such as a desktop pet and voice changing.

原文标题：腾讯首款 AI 游戏陪伴 Agent 鹅次元开启内测

Why it matters：大厂首次将多模态游戏画面理解与陪伴型 Agent 结合落地，是观察 AI 消费级 Agent 形态的重要样本。

item.title: Anthropic Moves Ahead With IPO at Valuation Below $1.5 Trillion
item.description:
Anthropic plans to set a valuation range this week and begin trading late next week, pushing ahead with its IPO despite a major Nasdaq sell-off, according to The Wall Street Journal. Some institutional investors are pressing for a valuation below the $1.5 trillion target discussed as recently as last week, itself well down from the $2 trillion floated months earlier. As OpenAI's main rival, Anthropic's pricing will serve as a key gauge of the current AI boom's strength.

原文标题：Anthropic 拟推进 IPO 估值或低于 1.5 万亿美元

Why it matters：头部 AI 公司 IPO 定价直接反映资本市场对 AI 热潮的信心，是产业周期的重要观察点。

item.title: China Unveils Nebula Constellation Plan to Put Data Centers in Space
item.description:
At the 2026 Space Cloud Industry Ecosystem Conference, the Aerospace Information Research Institute of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and domestic tech firms unveiled the Nebula Constellation Plan, a fully domestic space computing network. The initiative aims to merge remote sensing, communications and compute satellites into an intelligent space-based service system, moving space cloud from technical validation toward industrialization by using solar power and in-orbit processing to cut bandwidth use and latency.

原文标题：星云星座计划发布 把数据中心搬上太空

Why it matters：太空算力成为全球算力竞争新方向，该计划标志中国太空云生态进入产业化布局阶段。

item.title: Meta Releases Lightweight Muse Ember Model at One-Third Task Cost
item.description:
Meta has launched Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model to date, purpose-built for complex reasoning and high-frequency agentic workloads. It matches Claude Haiku 5.5 on the Artificial Analysis Index (36) at one-third the per-task cost, while leading on agentic and multimodal benchmarks such as AutomationBench-AA and OSWorld 2.1. The model is available immediately via Meta Model API, Google Cloud and Oracle Cloud, priced at $0.10/$0.50 per million input/output tokens.

原文标题：Meta 发布轻量模型 Muse Ember 单任务成本仅 1/3

Why it matters：轻量模型以 1/3 成本追平 Claude Haiku 5.5，且智能体基准显著领先，直接影响模型选型与推理成本决策。

item.title: Fireworks Hit by Hack Exposing Customer Data and Model Weights
item.description:
The Information reports that Fireworks, one of the highest-valued inference providers, was breached on October 24 via development machines hosted by a third-party cloud provider. The intrusion exposed customer billing records and, for some accounts, datasets and incomplete model weights. Customers including Harvey are now weighing a move off the platform, threatening Fireworks' billion-dollar business.

原文标题：Fireworks 遭黑客入侵 客户数据与模型权重泄露

Why it matters：头部推理服务商发生供应链侧数据泄露，直接牵动客户信任与平台迁移决策。

item.title: AWS Quick Encodes Repeatable Tasks with Skills and Agents
item.description:
An AWS blog post explains how agents, skills, and connected data sources fit together in AWS Quick: agents interpret natural-language requests and orchestrate connectors, while skills encode repeatable tasks such as weekly status updates, release notes, and ticket creation into reusable, team-shareable instruction units. It also covers combining the official skill catalog with custom agents, but remains a vendor-bound conceptual and how-to guide without new models or quantitative results.

原文标题：AWS Quick 用技能与智能体封装重复任务

Why it matters：有助于理解 AWS 智能体产品的技能抽象与复用机制，但为厂商绑定的概念说明，技术增量有限。

The update is up to 30% faster than Fable 5.1 and cheaper at $8/$40 per million tokens. Arena also showcased 17 generations spanning 3D worlds, playable games, website UI, data visualizations and interactive code-generated animations.

item.description:

The device offers 4K recording, 355-degree panning and dual-radar detection, priced at $300 standalone.

item.title: Apple Framework Lets General AI Models Control Robot Arms Zero-Shot at 85.6%
item.description:
A new Apple paper introduces AMP1, a harness that lets general-purpose frontier models such as Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon control a robot arm in a closed loop using camera views, code execution and direct motion commands, with no demonstrations or task-specific training. It achieves 85.6% zero-shot success on RoboLab-120 versus 49.2% for the best VLA and 42.9% for the best world-action model, and succeeds in 104 of 108 trials on a real Franka arm, though the robot idles much of each episode waiting on model inference.

原文标题：苹果新框架让通用大模型零样本操控机械臂成功率达 85.6%

Why it matters：该研究用通用大模型直接替代专用机器人策略并取得显著性能优势，为具身智能提供了一条绕开演示数据的新路径。

The IPO is seen as a key test of how the market values the AI industry.

item.title: Expo Team Unveils Exact Cross-Platform UI Framework
item.description:
The Expo team has released Exact, a cross-platform UI framework that runs the same code natively on web, macOS, iOS, and Linux, and is explicitly designed for AI coding agents to build, run, observe, and test apps. In a demo, Claude Code built a todo app and passed tests on all three platforms in about 57 minutes, with 26 KB of code versus React's 81 KB and roughly 99 ms edit latency.

原文标题：Expo 团队发布 Exact 跨平台 UI 框架

item.title: Claude Fable 5.2 Completes 23-Year-Old Black Hole Calculation
item.description:
Claude Fable 5.2 independently completed a tedious black hole formation calculation that physicists had left unfinished since 2003, finding that black holes form suddenly in tiny universes just as Hawking and Page showed for large ones in 1983. A physicist has verified the work, marking a case where an AI produced checkable new knowledge in fundamental physics rather than merely summarizing existing text.

原文标题：Claude Fable 5.2 独立完成 23 年未解黑洞计算

Why it matters：AI 独立完成并产出经人工核验的基础物理新结论，是模型科研能力的重要实证节点。

item.description:

Muse is already embedded in Instagram and Facebook, and the watch interface carries the yeti mascot motif, echoing the design of the Muse Charm device unveiled in September.

item.title: Google Expands Eighth-Gen TPU Lineup with 8tx and 8i Max
item.description:

The company is also broadening TPU accessibility through PyTorch and open-source stack support, strengthening its infrastructure position for the agentic era.

Why it matters：谷歌一年内连发四款第八代 TPU，以机密推理与超长上下文专用硬件直指智能体负载，是算力基础设施竞争的重要信号。

item.title: Claude Fable 5.2 Turns Short Prompts into Manufacturable Hardware Prototypes
item.description:
Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 converts short prompts into complete hardware packages—specs, schematics, board layouts, 3D-printable enclosures and firmware—for a speakerphone, voice-assistant hub and handheld virtual pet. Board maker Diode Computers fabricated all three directly from the model's files, skipping typical manufacturing revision cycles. Unlike earlier models whose layouts were 95% complete but unusable due to blocked wiring, Fable 5.2 autonomously reroutes traces and reassigns chip pins, scoring 69% on Diode's internal PCB Gym benchmark versus 25% for Fable 5 at roughly one-third the API cost.

原文标题：Claude Fable 5.2 从提示词直出可制造硬件原型

Why it matters：这是大模型首次端到端产出可直接投产的电子硬件设计，标志着 AI 从代码生成迈向物理制造的关键跨越。

item.title: UC Berkeley Supervisor Rebuilds Coding Agent Teams to Beat Expert GPU Kernels
item.description:
A new UC Berkeley paper introduces Evolving Agent Teams, in which a supervisor diagnoses plateaus in coding-agent teams and rebuilds roles such as profiler, debugger, and knowledge integrator, with a shared file system carrying lessons across teams. On the MLA decode kernel it reached 0.74x FlashInfer speed under the same token budget versus 0.31x for a fixed four-role team, and 1.21x with more budget, winning 36 of 47 production workloads.

原文标题：伯克利提出监督者动态重组编码智能体团队

Why it matters：该工作给出可复用的多智能体编排范式与量化对比，直接回应编码智能体性能停滞问题。

item.description:
